svg.title: openmeet-core: Settings root, AI providers and assistant behaviour (settings.rs)

g.text: openmeet-core: Settings root, AI providers and assistant behaviour (settings.rs)
Every field has a serde default, so settings
written by older versions keep loading.
sanitized() clamps numbers into safe ranges,
trims models and normalizes URLs; it is applied
to every update coming from the UI.
validate(): base URLs must be http(s), no
whitespace, no embedded credentials; LLM and
transcription model non-empty; base URL required
for Ollama / OpenaiCompatible; no duplicate shortcuts.
API keys are NOT part of Settings.
